dashboard.name: Chart Gallery
dashboard.description: One page per registered chart type — showcases every widget NeoBoard supports on the demo e-commerce and movies datasets.

chartOptions.content:
## Bar chart

Categorical comparison. Use for **revenue by category**, **orders by region**, or any dimension-vs-metric breakdown.

**Options shown:** `colorPalette: deep-ocean`, `showValues: true`, `showLegend: false`, `orientation: vertical`.

widgets.query: SELECT parent.name AS category, SUM(oi.qty * oi.price)::float AS revenue FROM neoboard_demo_public.order_items oi JOIN neoboard_demo_public.products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN neoboard_demo_public.categories sub ON sub.id = p.category_id JOIN neoboard_demo_public.categories parent ON parent.id = sub.parent_id GROUP BY parent.name ORDER BY revenue DESC

chartOptions.content:
## Line chart

Time-series trends. Use for **revenue over time**, **MAU curves**, any continuous sequence.

**Options shown:** `smooth: true`, `area: true`, `showLegend: true`.

widgets.query: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week', created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS week, SUM(total)::float AS revenue FROM neoboard_demo_public.orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

chartOptions.content:
## Pie / donut chart

Part-of-whole composition. Best when you have **5 or fewer slices** with meaningful proportions.

**Options shown:** `donut: true`, `showLegend: true`, `labelPosition: outside`.

widgets.query: SELECT status AS name, COUNT(*)::int AS value FROM neoboard_demo_public.orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY value DESC

chartOptions.content:
## Table

Row-level detail with sorting, pagination, and column controls. The workhorse for drilldown data.

**Options shown:** `enableSorting: true`, `enablePagination: true`, `pageSize: 10`, `enableColumnResizing: true`.

widgets.query: SELECT c.name AS customer, c.city, r.name AS region, SUM(o.total)::float AS total_spend, COUNT(o.id) AS orders FROM neoboard_demo_public.customers c JOIN neoboard_demo_public.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN neoboard_demo_public.regions r ON r.id = c.region_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.city, r.name ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 50

chartOptions.content:
## Single-value KPI

Hero number for a dashboard header — total revenue, active users, SLA percentage. Supports prefix/suffix and number formatting.

**Options shown:** `prefix: $`, `numberFormat: compact`, `decimalPlaces: 1`, `fontSize: xl`.

widgets.query: SELECT SUM(total)::float AS value FROM neoboard_demo_public.orders
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS value FROM neoboard_demo_public.orders
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS value FROM neoboard_demo_public.customers

chartOptions.content:
## Gauge

Single-value visualized against a scale with optional threshold zones. Use for **% SLA**, **% conversion**, any bounded 0–100 metric.

**Options shown:** `min: 0`, `max: 100`, `showProgress: true`.

widgets.query: SELECT 'Delivered' AS name, (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'delivered') * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::float AS value FROM neoboard_demo_public.orders

chartOptions.content:
## Markdown widget

Static content for annotations, explainers, section headers, and inline documentation inside a dashboard. No query required.

### What it supports

- **Headings** H1–H6
- **Bold**, *italic*, `inline code`
- Lists, links, and fenced code blocks

```sql
-- Even code blocks with syntax highlighting
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered';
```

| Feature | Supported |
|---|---|
| Tables | Yes |
| Images | No |
| HTML | No |

## iframe widget

Embed any external web content inside a dashboard — external docs, BI tools, map services, status pages. Sandboxed by default.

## JSON viewer

Collapsible tree view over raw query results. Best for **debugging query shape** or inspecting deeply-nested JSON columns.

**Options shown:** `initialExpanded: 2`.

widgets.query: SELECT o.id, o.status, o.total::float AS total, to_char(o.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS order_date, c.name AS customer, c.city FROM neoboard_demo_public.orders o JOIN neoboard_demo_public.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 5

chartOptions.content:
## Parameter select

Dashboard-level filter widget. Sets a `$param_<name>` value that other widgets can reference in their queries. Supports `select`, `text`, `date`, `date-range`, `number-range`, `multi-select`, and `cascading-select`.

**Options shown:** `parameterType: select`, seed query, searchable dropdown.

chartOptions.seedQuery: SELECT name AS value, name AS label FROM neoboard_demo_public.regions ORDER BY name

widgets.query: SELECT SUM(o.total)::float AS value FROM neoboard_demo_public.orders o JOIN neoboard_demo_public.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN neoboard_demo_public.regions r ON r.id = c.region_id WHERE r.name = $param_gallery_region

chartOptions.content:
## Form widget

Write-back form bound to a parameterized INSERT. Requires a **write-enabled connection**. This form writes to `neoboard_demo_public.feedback` on the demo PG connection.

**Fields shown:** `rating` (1–5), `category` (text), `comment` (text).

widgets.query: INSERT INTO neoboard_demo_public.feedback (rating, category, comment) VALUES ($param_rating_min::int, $param_category, $param_comment) RETURNING id

formFields.label: Comment
formFields.placeholder: What went well / what could improve?

widgets.query: SELECT id, rating, category, comment, to_char(submitted_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS submitted FROM neoboard_demo_public.feedback ORDER BY submitted_at DESC LIMIT 20

chartOptions.content:
## Graph widget (NVL)

Native graph visualization over a Neo4j result. Returns nodes and relationships as-is — NVL handles force layout, labels, and interaction.

**Options shown:** `layout: force`, `showLabels: true`. Uses the Neo4j *movies* dataset.

widgets.query: MATCH (p:Person)-[r]->(m:Movie) RETURN p, r, m LIMIT 40

chartOptions.content:
## Map (Leaflet)

Geographic visualization with marker clustering and auto-fit bounds. Query must return `lat` and `lng` columns.

**Options shown:** `autoFitBounds: true`, `clusterMarkers: true`.

widgets.query: SELECT name, city, lat, lng FROM neoboard_demo_public.customers

chartOptions.content:
## Sankey diagram

Flow visualization between two (or more) categorical dimensions. Query must return `source`, `target`, `value` columns.

**Options shown:** `orient: horizontal`, `showLabels: true`.

widgets.query: SELECT r.name AS source, o.status AS target, COUNT(*)::float AS value FROM neoboard_demo_public.orders o JOIN neoboard_demo_public.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN neoboard_demo_public.regions r ON r.id = c.region_id GROUP BY r.name, o.status

chartOptions.content:
## Treemap

Proportional rectangles — each box's area is its value relative to the total. Good for **top-N breakdowns** or hierarchical data.

**Options shown:** `showLabels: true`, `showValues: true`, `colorSaturation: medium`.

widgets.query: SELECT p.name AS name, SUM(oi.qty * oi.price)::float AS value FROM neoboard_demo_public.order_items oi JOIN neoboard_demo_public.products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 30

chartOptions.content:
## Sunburst

Radial hierarchy. Center ring is the root; outer rings expand detail. Alternative to treemap when you want to emphasize hierarchy over proportions.

**Options shown:** `showLabels: true`, `sort: desc`, `highlightOnHover: true`.

widgets.query: SELECT p.name AS name, SUM(oi.qty * oi.price)::float AS value FROM neoboard_demo_public.order_items oi JOIN neoboard_demo_public.products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 30

chartOptions.content:
## Radar chart

Compare a small set of entities across 3+ metrics on a radial axis. Best with fewer than 4 series so the polygons remain readable.

**Data shape:** query returns `indicator` + `value` columns. Add a `series` column for multi-entity comparisons.

**Options shown:** `shape: polygon`, `filled: true`, `showLegend: true`.

widgets.query: SELECT 'orders' AS indicator, COUNT(*)::float AS value FROM neoboard_demo_public.orders UNION ALL SELECT 'customers', COUNT(*)::float FROM neoboard_demo_public.customers UNION ALL SELECT 'products', COUNT(*)::float FROM neoboard_demo_public.products UNION ALL SELECT 'order_items', COUNT(*)::float FROM neoboard_demo_public.order_items UNION ALL SELECT 'feedback', COUNT(*)::float FROM neoboard_demo_public.feedback
